statement: Independent secondary Xbox 360 wired XUSB reference describes two bytes of digital buttons (A/B/X/Y, shoulder/guide, start/back/sticks, D-pad) and eight-bit analog triggers at 4 and 5 in the 20-byte 00 14 input report.
